{{Quote|I saw amazing things. Traveled the stars with my master, before a darkness took me. But that was long ago…|Barriss Offee reflects on her journey|<ref name="The Way Out" />}}
'''Barriss Offee''', also known under the titles of "'''the healer'''" and "'''wise mother'''" later in her life, was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan]] [[Gender|female]] who, during the Republic Era, was a [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] who fell to the [[dark side of the Force]] during the period of the [[Clone Wars]] and was an [[Inquisitor]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Trained as a [[Padawan]] under [[Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli]], Offee wielded a [[Color|blue]] [[lightsaber]] that she used when participating in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. She preferred studying ancient [[Jedi]] texts to fighting. During her time as a [[Jedi]] Padawan, Offee forged a friendship with [[Ahsoka Tano]], the Padawan of [[Anakin Skywalker]]. Though rather different in personality, the two bonded through their shared experience in combat, including at the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]].

As the Clone Wars continued, Offee grew disillusioned with the Jedi's role in the conflict, believing they had strayed from the ideals that the [[Jedi Order]] was supposed to represent, becoming particularly wary of the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]]. Deciding to act on her concerns, she orchestrated the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombing]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] as a means to foment further distrust of the Jedi. Despite their previous friendship, she allowed Tano to be framed for orchestrating the bombing, even going as far as impersonating former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]] to frame her former friend. Skywalker ultimately ended up catching Offee and bringing her to justice. Offee finally confessed just moments before Tano was convicted of the crime, clearing the Togruta's name. Offee expressed her views of the Jedi Order in front of the tribunal, showing that she had been corrupted by the dark side before being taken away.

During the [[Imperial Era]], Offee was inducted into the ranks of the [[Inquisitorius]], but she ultimately renounced her allegiance with them after witnessing their needless cruelty. Barriss reclaimed her identity as a Jedi and became a wandering [[Jedi healer|healer]], helping those in need. Years later, she was eventually hunted down and gravely injured by the [[Fourth Sister]], formerly her friend within the Jedi Order known as Lyn Rakish, though the Inquisitor became empathetic for Offee and sought to save her thereafter.

==Biography==
===Early Life===
{{Quote|My time as a youngling seems so far away, although it has not been that many years ago. I am sorry I had to leave your lesson before speaking with you. My master called for me.|Barriss Offee, to Tutso Mara|<ref name="A Jedi's Duty" />}}
Some [[time]] prior to the [[Border dispute on Ansion|border dispute on]] [[Ansion]],<ref name="Episode II" /> the [[Gender|female]] [[Mirialan]] Barriss Offee was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Mirial]]. She was found to be [[Force-sensitive]] and was brought into the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] to [[Jedi training|train]] as a [[Jedi]]<ref name="databank" /> just as [[Barriss Offee's family|her family]] faced a difficult situation due to others feeling scared by her abilities.<ref name="The Way Out" /> During her [[time]] as part of an [[Barriss Offee's Initiate clan|Initiate clan]], Offee and her clan wandered through the high archways and manicured courtyards of the [[Great Hall (Jedi Temple)|Great Hall]], which Offee marveled at.<ref name="A Jedi's Duty" /> She became [[Padawan]] to [[Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli]].<ref name="databank" /> At some point, she studied [[lightsaber]] techniques with [[Tutso Mara]], and the two grew to become close.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Both Unduli and Offee were also considered to be [[Jedi Vanguard]]s.<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>

===The Secessionist Movement===
{{Quote|The arena on Geonosis was a lot to deal with and I am not too proud to admit that I was scared.|Barriss Offee, to [[Sabé]] on her experiences of fighting in the Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="Queen's Hope">''[[Queen's Hope]]''</ref>}}
[[File:FiveFamousJediContinueToFailToDetectTheSith-AotC.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Barriss sits in on meeting between the Jedi Council and Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine.]]
Offee, along with Unduli, sat in on a meeting between the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] and [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who discussed the growing influence of the [[Separatist Crisis|Secessionist Movement]], and the threat of an imminent war between them and the [[Galactic Republic]]. After, Offee was present in [[Chancellor]] Palpatine's office with other [[senator]]s and Jedi as the issue of whether Palpatine should take emergency powers was debated.<ref name="Episode II" />

Later, Offee, along with her master, were part of the [[Jedi assault team]] sent to [[First Battle of Geonosis|rescue]] Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker]] from the [[Petranaki Arena|execution arena]] on [[Geonosis]]. The Mirialan survived the battle, as did her master, though the [[Clone Wars]] had only just begun.<ref name="Episode II" /> After the battle, Offee had trouble [[sleep]]ing and volunteered to watch over several injured Jedi in the [[Jedi Temple medical bay|Temple clinic]], and due to what Jedi Master [[Depa Billaba]] later described as Offee's special attention, the injured were able to recover.<ref name="Queen's Hope" />

===The Clone Wars===
====Avoiding the fighting====
Four [[Standard month|months]] into the war, Offee and her master traveled to the planet [[Ilum]], where Offee was to complete her [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber|final lightsaber]]. However, they became embroiled in a [[Ambush at Ilum|Separatist ambush]]. The [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Jedi Temple]] on Ilum was nearly destroyed during the engagement, but Offee and Unduli were saved by [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]].<ref name="Force Users">{{EncyclopediaCite|Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force}}</ref> As her Master became a [[Jedi General]], Offee did not go out to war with her and instead remained at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and continued to volunteer in the medical clinic where she found solace in helping the injured Jedi. Although, Offee found it difficult to deal with so many Jedi harmed by the war, their pain reflecting her own. Distressed by this, Offee knew she could not heal their mental wounds.<ref name="A Jedi's Duty">{{StoryCite|story=A Jedi's Duty|book=Stories of Jedi and Sith}}</ref>

[[File:Barriss_Offee_during_a_dangerous_mission.jpg|thumb|right|229px|Barriss during her mission to retrieve an old book.]]
In [[21 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> she was sent by Unduli to retrieve an old [[book]]. During the mission, she encountered a creature and many traps. When she finally reached the location of the book, she picked up the book and it turned to sand. Later, she returned and told her master that she had failed. Unduli told Offee that she did not fail because she never expected Offee to actually bring it back, that it was about the journey and everything she did to find the book.<ref name="The Journey">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=20|story=Tales from Wild Space: The Journey}}</ref>

====Second Battle of Geonosis====
[[File:OldThumbnail-Weapons-Factory.png|thumb|left|220px|Barriss and Ahsoka infiltrate the Geonosian Catacombs.]]
In 21 BBY,<ref name="A Jedi's Duty date">"[[A Jedi's Duty]]" takes place shortly before the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[21 BBY]].</ref> Offee's internal turmoil prevented her ability to heal others, with the Temple clinic becoming a place that caused her feeling of pain. Despite this, she returned to her Master's side<ref name="A Jedi's Duty" /> and accompanied her back to Geonosis in order to assist the forces of Anakin Skywalker, alongside his Padawan learner of almost the same age as Offee, [[Ahsoka Tano]]. After Offee memorized the trails, herself and Tano attempted to infiltrate a large [[Geonosian]] [[droid]] and [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|weapons factory]]. Offee and her master found Tano and Skywalker arguing over their tactical strategy upon arrival, and Offee unintentionally annoyed Tano with her authoritative personality. Leaving their masters to launch a frontal attack, both Padawans sneaked through the [[Geonosian catacombs]] below in order to plant explosive [[grenade]]s from within. They were, however, discovered by [[Poggle the Lesser]] and his Geonosian [[Separatist super-tank prototype|super-tank]]. After Tano was rendered unconscious, Barriss was left with a choice: the bombs, or Tano's life. Ultimately, Offee and Tano decided to use the [[tank]] to destroy the reactor, knowing the explosion would [[Death|kill]] them in the process. However, due to the tough exterior armor of the tank, both Padawans survived, much to the relief of their respective masters. Following their ordeal, Offee and Tano, having strengthened their bond, temporarily retired from the battlefield in order to recuperate.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

====Skirmish aboard TB-73====
{{Quote|Kill me… please.|Offee briefly regains control of herself and pleads Tano to kill her|<ref name="Brain Invaders">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>}}
[[File:BarrissInfected-BrainInvaders.jpg|thumb|right|256px|An infected Barriss attacks Ahsoka on board the TB-73.]]
Shortly after Offee and Tano recovered from their wounds, they were tasked with making a supply run to [[Mace Windu]] on [[Dantooine]] from a station near [[Ord Cestus]] aboard the [[Pelta-class frigate|medical frigate]] [[TB-73]]. Unknown to either Padawan, a swarm of Geonosian [[brain worm]]s had been brought on board by infected [[clone trooper]] [[Scythe (clone trooper)|Scythe]]. Soon, the rest of the [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Tango Company]] were infected. Offee was infected herself after she and Tano were separated. She proceeded to stalk her friend across the ship, attacking and nearly killing her with her lightsaber. Offee again chased Tano around the ship, but Tano escaped. Eventually, as the ship neared a medical station, Offee was freed from the parasite's brain control after Tano ruptured the coolant system, causing low [[temperature]]s that would kill the worms. Offee begged for Tano to kill her instead of letting her stay infected, but Tano sliced the parasite in half instead, freeing her friend. When the ship docked at the medical station, Both Tano and Offee were taken to the medical wing of the station by Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto]] to recover.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

====Further missions====
Offee went on to undertake many missions alongside Tano,<ref name="SagaofOffee">{{SW|url=news/barriss-offee|text=The Saga of Barriss Offee}}</ref> with whom she grew close.<ref name="AhsokavMaul">''[[The Clone Wars: Ahsoka vs. Maul]]''</ref> However, those same missions exposed Offee to the true horrors of war.<ref name="SagaofOffee" /> At some point, Offee was captured on the planet [[Felucia]], but she was rescued by Jedi [[General]] [[Aayla Secura]] and Clone Commander [[Bly]].<ref name="Bly Card">{{ForceCollection|Clone Commander Bly|star=4}} {{C|Light}}</ref> Offee was present in the [[Jedi temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] when General [[Grievous]] sent a message to the Order, informing them of the [[Capture of Eeth Koth|capture]] of fellow Jedi [[Eeth Koth]]. Offee witnessed his brutal [[torture]] and left the room along with the [[Jedi Initiate|younglings]] after they were dismissed by Master Yoda.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>

At some point in 21 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], shortly before [[Cato Parasitti]]'s [[assassin]]ation attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala, Offee trained with Tano in the Jedi Temple. Offee was critical of her friend's unorthodox fighting methods, stating that [[Lightsaber duel|duels]] were meant to prepare Jedi for real encounters on the battlefield, and using non-traditional tactics served no purpose. Although Tano disagreed, the two acknowledged this difference in opinion as a result of their master's vastly different teaching style.<ref name="FoD Ahsoka & Padmé">''[[Forces of Destiny—Ahsoka & Padmé]]''</ref>

[[File:BarrissOffee-SWZ.png|thumb|left|300px|Offee piloting her Delta-7B interceptor over Umbara.]]
During the [[Battle of Umbara]], Offee flew her [[Barriss Offee's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|starfighter]] alongside her friend Tano and Republic forces attacking the [[Umbara blockade|Separatist blockade]] over the planet of [[Umbara]]. After the [[blockade]] was broken through, ground forces, including Anakin Skywalker and his [[501st Legion]] as well as Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his [[212th Attack Battalion]], were able to land onto the planet to combat the [[Umbaran Militia|local resistance]].<ref name="Darkness on Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> Offee later attended the [[Funeral of Obi-Wan Kenobi|faux funeral]] of Master Kenobi after he was seemingly assassinated by [[bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen]].<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>

During a [[Mission on Drongar|single mission]] on [[Drongar]]<ref name="English Ahsoka and Others">{{EncyclopediaCite|Ahsoka Tano and Other Users of the Force}} (English version)</ref> in the Outer Rim,<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> Offee encountered the [[dark side of the Force]] when a natural [[plant]] extract increased her Force sensitivity to dangerously high levels.<ref name="English Ahsoka and Others" />

====Bombing of the Jedi Temple====
{{Quote|I did it. Because I've come to realize what ''many'' people in the Republic have come to realize. That the ''Jedi'' are the ones responsible for this war. That we've so lost our way that we have become ''villains'' in this conflict. That ''we'' are the ones that should be put on trial. ''All'' of us! And my attack on the Temple was an attack on what the Jedi have become. An army fighting for the dark side. Fallen from the light that we once held ''so'' dear. This Republic is ''failing!'' It's only a matter of time.|Barriss Offee's confession|<ref name="The Wrong Jedi">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>}}
[[File:BarrissOffeeDark-TCWForceWarriors.png|thumb|right|300px|Offee stole Ventress' lightsabers to incriminate her in the conspiracy.]]
By the last year of the war,<ref name="Ahsoka and Others">{{EncyclopediaCite|Ahsoka Tano and Other Users of the Force}}</ref> Offee's views on the Jedi and their role in [[the galaxy]] had become distorted.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> Particularly due to the ever growing number of clone troopers whom she saw injured or killed in action,<ref name="Redemption229">{{InsiderCite|229|The Redemption of Barriss Offee}}</ref> she came to believe that both the Jedi and the Republic had lost their way<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> in favor of waging<ref name="InnerJedi">''[[Star Wars: Inner Jedi]]''</ref> the costly<ref name="Redemption229" /> war against the Separatist Alliance.<ref name="InnerJedi" /> Believing that the Jedi Order had given into the dark side, become the villains of the Clone Wars,<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> and was fighting the conflict at the expense of putting effort into protecting the common people of the galaxy,<ref name="InnerJedi" /> Offee came into contact with [[Letta Turmond]],<ref name="Redemption229" /> a [[Coruscanti]] anti-war<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> activist<ref name="Redemption229" /> and terrorist<ref name="Join the Battle" /> who opposed the Jedi's involvement in the Clone Wars. Offee shared Turmond's beliefs and decided that it was time to make a statement against the Order. Showing Turmond how to use [[NM-K reconstitutor|nano-droids]] as a bomb, Offee had Turmond feed the droids to her husband, [[Jackar Bowmani]], a munitions expert at the Jedi Temple. The nano-droids [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|exploded]] when Bowmani went into the Temple hangar, killing several Jedi, clones, civilians, and Republic military personnel<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> in [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines" /> during the final months of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Redemption229" />

Offee attended the [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims|funeral]] for the fallen Jedi, which included her old friend Mara. Later, she conversed with Ahsoka Tano about moving past negative feelings towards the bombing.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> Offee hoped that she could endear Tano to her cause, possibly hoping to secure a full partnership with Tano in her conspiracy, but resolved to manipulate Tano so as to reach those ends.<ref name="Ahsoka">[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']]</ref> Afterward, she [[Force choke]]d Turmond in her prison cell before she could reveal Offee's involvement, allowing Tano to be accused of killing Turmond. Then, she freed Tano from the prison and attacked and killed several clone troopers, further incriminating Tano.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> She then pretended to help Tano investigate Turmond’s murder via [[comlink]], providing her false intel and leading her to an [[Abandoned munitions warehouse|abandoned explosive warehouse]] containing crates of nano-droids, the same droids found at the scene of the crime. Offee ambushed Ventress, stealing her mask and lightsabers. Offee then attacked Tano herself, disguised as former [[assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" />

[[File:BarrissInCourt-TWJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Offee testifies during Tano's trial]]
After Tano was discovered by Republic clones, she was blamed for the bombing and put back under containment. After a short Council meeting, Offee's former friend was expelled from the Jedi Order. Anakin Skywalker, angry and suspicious of his Padawan's expulsion, [[Force choke|interrogated]] Ventress, who revealed that someone had stolen her lightsabers. Visiting Offee in her Temple chambers, Skywalker spoke to her, and then [[Duel at the Jedi Temple|attacked]] her with her own lightsaber. Offee, in self-defense, used the Force to grab [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers|Ventress' lightsabers]], which she had hidden in a nearby vase, thereby revealing herself. Though Offee was able to defend herself and stand her ground for a prolonged period of time, Skywalker captured her by using the Force. Skywalker burst in during Tano's [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano|trial]] with Offee, who was [[Stuncuffs|handcuffed]] and being led by several [[Jedi Temple Guard]]s,<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> one of whom would eventually become the future [[The Grand Inquisitor|Grand Inquisitor]].<ref name="Forbes SWRS2 Finale">{{WebCite|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/lukethompson/2016/03/29/review-star-wars-rebels-season-finale-non-spoiler-and-the-inquisitors-past-revealed|text=Reaction: 'Star Wars Rebels' Season Finale <nowiki>[Non-Spoiler]</nowiki>, And The Inquisitor's Past Revealed|author=Thompson, Luke Y.|work=[[Wikipedia:Forbes|Forbes]]|archivedate=20200131114328}}</ref>

Skywalker demanded that she tell the full truth; Offee admitted she did it because she had come to believe the Jedi were the ones responsible for the war, and that they were the real villains of the conflict. Offee claimed that the Jedi have become [[Sith]]-like, as if they were not like they used to be. Offee was then taken away while Tano was cleared of all charges. Tano was offered to return to the Order, but she refused and left, feeling betrayed by both the Order and her former friend.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> As a result of Offee's admission, she was imprisoned.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>

===Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire===
====Inquisitorial inquiry====
{{Quote|Just be glad you're not a Jedi anymore. By tomorrow, they won't exist.|A shock trooper, to Barriss Offee|<ref name="Devoted" />}}
For the remainder of the war, Offee was incarcerated at the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]]. In the final days of the war, Offee suddenly awoke from a nightmare of death and destruction. She peered outside her cell window to see that it was true: a massive [[Operation: Knightfall|attack on the Jedi Temple]] was underway. She rushed to her door to ask the [[Imperial shock trooper|shock trooper]] guards what was happening, but they did not reveal much other than [[Unidentified clone shock trooper (cell guard)|one of them]] telling her to be grateful that she was no longer a Jedi.<ref name="Devoted" />

Later, Offee received a visit from fellow Jedi [[Fourth Sister|Lyn Rakish]], only Rakish no longer appeared to be a Jedi and had joined the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius program, taking on the identity of the "Fourth Sister".<!--Not explicit, but credits say Fourth Sister and Rakish says she doesn't go by that name in episode itself--> In that moment, the former Jedi stated that Offee was correct in her accusations against the Jedi, claiming that the Jedi Council had attempted to seize control of the Republic and [[Duel in Palpatine's office|assassinate]] Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="Devoted" /> In response, the Republic branded all Jedi as traitors, and Palpatine issued [[Order 66]], commanding clone troopers to kill all Jedi.<ref name="USW" /> The Fourth Sister offered Offee an opportunity, and with limited options and the pressure of clones' blasters, she accepted the offer, resulting in the Fourth Sister freeing her.<ref name="Devoted" />

[[File:Barriss-Offee-Clone-Guards.png|thumb|291x291px|Barriss Offee was released from the Republic Center for Military Operations to become an Inquisitor.]]
Offee was taken to [[Fortress Inquisitorius]],<ref name="Devoted" /> a facility on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] [[Nur]] in the [[Mustafar system]].<ref name="Fortress DB">{{Databank|fortress-inquisitorius|Fortress Inquisitorius}}</ref> She arrived with two other Jedi she also recognized: [[Dante]] and [[Ahmar]]. The [[Grand Inquisitor]] then entered, explaining that the Jedi had fallen and that the Republic had been reorganized into the First [[Galactic Empire]]. The Grand Inquisitor offered the former Jedi the opportunity to prove themselves worthy in joining him in executing now-Emperor Palpatine's vision. The trio retired to their quarters but not before the Grand Inquisitor warned them to stay put.<ref name="Devoted" />

====A new future====
{{Quote|The lessons you learned from the Jedi greatly limit your power. But I will help you overcome this weakness.|The Grand Inquisitor|<ref name="Devoted" />}}
Ahmar was desperate to leave, unconvinced that the Empire would be an improvement over the Jedi. Offee cautioned him to stay, but he did not care, nor was he concerned about Offee and Dante's fate once he left, exiting. He did not return, and Fourth Sister later arrived to take the remaining Jedi. They once again spoke with the Grand Inquisitor, who claimed Ahmar had met with a terrible accident. Dante then went with Fourth Sister for training, while Offee was left with the Grand Inquisitor.<ref name="Devoted" />

[[File:BarrissInquisitorTraining-TotE.png|thumb|left|300px|Barriss trains with the Grand Inquisitor]]
He instructed her to attack him with a lightsaber, easily dodging all of her advances. He taunted her for fighting like a Jedi and hit her in the face, angering her. Offee was able to tap into her anger and graze the Grand Inquisitor's shoulder, of which he approved, though he knocked her down to the ground on her next advance. As he commented on her apparent lack of power, Offee launched the Inquisitor back with the Force, crumpling him against the wall. He smiled at Offee's anger.<ref name="Devoted" />

Soon after, several clone troopers led Offee into an arena with a pit in the middle, with the Grand Inquisitor and Fourth Sister overlooking as Dante entered as well. The Grand Inquisitor threw a single lightsaber down and explained that whoever survived would join their ranks and that if they chose not to fight, both would die, as a force field slowly forced them both closer to the pit. Offee was initially skeptical that they would kill both of them, but Dante, remembering Ahmar, grabbed the lightsaber and leapt toward his former ally.<ref name="Devoted" />

Offee was ultimately victorious, [[Force choke|snapping Dante's neck]] and pushing him down the pit to his death. She appeared surprised by her actions as the other Inquisitors descended, with Fourth Sister presenting her with a [[helmet]] to indicate her new role. Shortly after, now donning full Inquisitorial garb, Offee was joined by [[Eleventh Brother]], Fourth Sister, and [[Marrok|First Brother]]. They all knelt to the Grand Inquisitor, who introduced them to their new master, to whom he also knelt: the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader.<ref name="Devoted" />

====Realization====
{{Quote|The Jedi are a threat to be eradicated, wherever they are found.''"<br />"''Then you have one Jedi left to deal with.|The Fourth Sister and Barriss Offee|<ref name="Realization">{{TOTE|Realization}}</ref>}}
[[File:BarrissOffee-Platinum2025.png|thumb|right|250px|Barriss Offee served as an Imperial Inquisitor.]]
Over a short time,<ref name="Realization" /> Offee was involved in the hunt for many surviving Jedi<ref name="Redemption229" /> and often worked with the Fourth Sister.<ref name="SWEComp">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> One day, still early in her service to the Inquisitorius, Offee joined the Fourth Sister in tracking down a [[Unidentified human Jedi|fledgeling Jedi]]. Landing on the planet where, according to their intel, the Jedi was hiding, they began questioning locals living in a small settlement on the Jedi's whereabouts. While the Fourth Sister questioned the townspeople with aggression, Offee took a softer approach and was able to learn of the Jedi's location from a small child, assuaging his fears with her more gentle temperament. Frustrated by their deception, the Fourth Sister slaughtered the townspeople while<ref name="Realization" /> an appalled<ref name="Redemption229" /> Offee watched, all while the child clung to her in terror.<ref name="Realization" />

The two eventually found the Jedi's hideout in the mountains, and the Fourth Sister immediately engaged them in battle. However, she was overpowered by them, forcing Offee to intervene. The two force users clashed, with Offee desperately trying to convince the Jedi to give up the fight and submit to the Empire. The Jedi, for a brief moment, considered Offee's propositions before suddenly being slashed in the back by the Fourth Sister, who kicked their body to the ground. Offee insisted that they bring the Jedi to the ship to save them as they were still alive, but Fourth Sister chided her, not caring that the Jedi was going to surrender but instead concerned with eradicating Jedi all across the galaxy. In retaliation, Offee replied that the Fourth Sister had one Jedi left to deal with, but before Fourth Sister could attack her, Offee [[Force push]]ed her fellow Inquisitor off the mountainside, defying the Empire. Offee then held the Jedi as they lay dying, promising that she would not let them die nor leave them alone<ref name="Realization" /> before tending to the Jedi as they died.<ref name="Redemption229" /> Barriss's betrayal made her a target of the Inquisitorius, but the lack of progress in locating her nearly resulted in the abandonment of the search.<ref name="The Way Out" />

===Life as a healer===
{{Quote|There is no way out, is there?''"<br />"''That's what the Empire wants you to think.|The Fourth Sister and Barriss Offee|<ref name="The Way Out">{{TOTE|The Way Out}}</ref>}}
[[File:BarrissOffee-TOTE.png|thumb|left|200px|Barriss Offee adopted the life of a healer and wise maternal figure.]]
Years later, having left the Empire behind, Barriss Offee became known as "the healer" and was known to assist travelers in need of help with her inherent abilities from a small encampment on a [[Unidentified astronomical object (Barriss Offee)|snowy world]]. She became close friends with a small, ragtag group who followed her with great respect and admiration, calling her "wise mother." After she was visited by a [[Micah's mother|mother]] and [[Micah's father|father]] with a small [[Micah|child]] with Force abilities, which the Empire sought, Offee told them about her own experiences as a Jedi and how the Order would take in young children to train them in the ways of the old.<ref name="The Way Out" />

Offee sent them in her starship to an [[Barriss Offee's friend|old friend]] following the sudden arrival of the Fourth Sister, who had been tracking the child. Offee allowed her old colleague to pursue her target into a nearby cave, where she kept the Inquisitor at bay by probing her with doubts about her loyalty to the Empire. The Fourth Sister swung wildly at the walls of the cave with her lightsaber in frustration but was unable to find the path out. In her anger, she accidentally impaled Offee through the stomach, gravely wounding her. The Mirialan fell to the ground, but was caught by the Fourth Sister. Promising to save her, the Fourth Sister held her injured friend, and only then was she able to exit, carrying her body outside with her [[Fourth Sister's hilt|Inquisitor lightsaber]] left behind as a [[rodent]] watched.<ref name="The Way Out" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Barriss Offee was wrong about a lot of things. She let her anger cloud her judgement and she tried to justify her actions without considering their wider effects. She was afraid of the war and she didn't trust people she should've listened to. But she had a point about the Republic and the Jedi. There was something wrong with them, and we were too locked into our traditions to see what it was. Barriss should've done something else. She shouldn't have killed anyone, and she definitely shouldn't have framed me for it, but if we'd listened to her—really listened—we might have been able to stop Palpatine before he took power.|Ahsoka Tano expressing her feelings over Barriss Offee's actions|<ref name="Ahsoka" />}}
Offee's betrayal had a deep impact on Ahsoka Tano and the Jedi Order itself. Months after Offee's arrest, [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] supported the idea of [[Death penalty|executing]] the fallen Jedi [[Quinlan Vos]], citing Offee's treachery as a sign that the Jedi had a problem with traitors within their own ranks.<ref name="Dark Disciple">''[[Dark Disciple]]''</ref> Unduli was shaken by the betrayal of her Padawan, eventually seeking solace by turning her attention to repairing the damage Separatist attacks had brought to [[Kachirho]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk]]. Ultimately, she spent months preparing for the eventual [[Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

Eventually, just as Barriss predicted, the Jedi Order [[Order 66|fell]] with the final stage of [[Darth]] Sidious' [[Grand Plan|plans]] for [[the galaxy]], and the Republic was [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] into the tyrannical [[Galactic Empire]]. One year into the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the Empire, Tano was still haunted by Offee's betrayal and later expressed her belief that while Offee's actions were wrong, she did have a point about the Jedi and the Republic, and that if they had truly listened to her, they might have been able to stop Darth Sidious before it was too late. Listening to what Tano had to say about her former friend, Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] took it to mean that, unlike people like Offee who focused on the past or those who would focus on the future, they needed to focus on the present.<ref name="Ahsoka" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've learned that ''trust'' is overrated. The only thing the Jedi Council believes in is ''violence!|Barriss Offee, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />}}
[[File:Stories_of_Jedi_and_Sith_Barriss.png|thumb|right|300px|Barriss Offee did not want to take part in the Clone Wars.]]
Barriss Offee was a Mirialan female who had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, yellow skin with black diamond shaped [[tattoo]]s, and a height of 1.66 [[meter]]s.<ref name="databank" /> Offee was considered a seemingly ideal example of a Jedi Padawan by some members of the Order.<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> She was an intelligent,<ref name="Pocket">''[[Star Wars Jedi Pocket Expert]]''</ref> daring and studious individual, able to memorize the entire layout of the system of Geonosian catacombs when her master asked her to.<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> She was also quite selfless as she pleaded with her friend Ahsoka Tano to kill her when she was being mind-controlled by a brain worm, though Tano refused.<ref name="Brain Invaders" />

After her experiences in the Battle of Geonosis and not wanting to become a warrior, she did not wish to take part in the Clone Wars, yet she would find herself heading back to Geonosis, and with it the war itself, for its second battle.<ref name="A Jedi's Duty" /> Afterward, she would continue to fight in the conflict.<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" /> As the Clone Wars dragged on, Offee grew to believe that the Republic and Jedi Order were the ones responsible, viewing the latter's role in the war as a betrayal of the Order's ideals.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Her corruption was due in part to when she touched the dark side on Drongar after intaking a substance that made her more powerful, but in a dangerous manner.<ref name="English Ahsoka and Others" /> Her growing disillusionment eventually led her to bomb the Jedi Temple, killing several civilians, clones and fellow Jedi, including her friend [[Tutso Mara]]. She even murdered her co-conspirator Letta Turmond to keep her betrayal a secret and framed her friend Tano for the deed.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> Reflecting on her former friend's actions, Tano believed Offee had been trying to convince her to have sympathy for her or outright convince her join together against the Jedi. However, she deemed the way Offee worked her into the plot, by framing her to take away her choices, to be the worst thing she could have done.<ref name="Ahsoka" />

[[File:BarrissTheInquisitor-Realization.png|thumb|left|200px|Barriss as an Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire, following her turn to the dark side.]]
In doing all of this, however, she fell to the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]]; during her duel with Anakin Skywalker, he chastised her for not getting rid of Ventress' red lightsabers, to which she snidely responded, "I think they suit me." When taken before the court, Offee finally confessed her crimes, thereby acquitting Tano, but nevertheless maintained her belief that the Jedi and the Republic had lost their way, expressing no remorse for bombing the Jedi Temple or framing Ahsoka, although a sad look given toward her friend indicated she at least regretted the rift these actions had now created between them.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

With her fall into the dark side,<ref name="The Way Out" /> Offee initially tried to dedicate herself to the Empire as an Inquisitor,<ref name="Devoted" /> although she went onto realize acting as an Imperial servant did not match her personal morals. After identifying herself as a Jedi once more,<ref name="Realization" /> she took up the life of a healer and wanted to help Force-sensitives escape the Empire. She even hoped to bring her old friend Lyn Rakish back to the light as well.<ref name="The Way Out" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:BarrissStopsLightsaber-TWO.png|thumb|right|300px|Offee stops the Fourth Sister's lightsaber with the Force.]]
As with any other Jedi, Barriss Offee was Force-sensitive. She was skilled in the use of [[telekinesis]],<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> enabling her to utilize [[Force push]] during battle.<ref name="Realization" /> She also could [[Force choke|use the Force to strangle people]], without needing to see her victim, such as she did to frame Ahsoka Tano and hide her own fall to the dark side.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much" /> She was trained in [[Form III]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> She was also skilled in [[Jar'Kai]]; with Ventress' lightsabers, she was able to overwhelm Tano—who, at the time, had use of only one lightsaber. When she was against Skywalker and tapped into the dark side, Offee used her two stolen blades to duel Anakin on even footing for a time, but lost when Skywalker exploited Offee's distraction by the presence of other Jedi and put her in a Force hold, thus subduing her.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" /><ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />

During her second match with the Fourth Sister, Offee held the Inquisitor off with unarmed combat alone.<ref name="The Way Out" /> [[Stass Allie]] passed on [[Force healing]] expertise to Offee.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> She also had some [[pilot]]ing skills, which she demonstrated during the Battle of Umbara.<ref name="Darkness on Umbara" />

==Equipment==
[[File:BarrissOffeeAttire-SW100Objects.png|thumb|left|170px|Barriss Offee's Jedi robes]]
{{Quote|Funny. Those belong to ''Ventress.'' You should've gotten rid of them.''"<br />"''I think they suit me.|Anakin Skywalker duels Barriss Offee|<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" />}}
As a Padawan,<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> Offee wore a hybrid Mirialan-Jedi Padawan outfit including a black [[Clothing|robe]] and a dark blue [[Cloak|cape]].<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> After her fall into the dark side,<ref name="The Way Out" /> she wore Asajj Ventress's helmet in order to impersonate her and conceal her own identity alongside a black skin-tight outfit and a black cloak.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" /> During her time in the [[Inquisitorius]], Barriss wore a standard black [[Inquisitor]] uniform alongside a helmet, which she abandoned upon denouncing the Empire.<ref name="Realization" /> She later went on to wear a brown fur coat while living as a healer on a snowy world.<ref name="The Way Out" />

Offee carried her own [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber|blue-bladed lightsaber]] during her time as a Jedi.<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> She eventually went on to steal Ventress's [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers|twin red lightsabers]] in order to pose as the former Sith assassin. Reasoning that they suited her, she kept hold of the two lightsabers and hid them within her Jedi Temple quarters, ultimately using them in combat against Anakin Skywalker until her arrest.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> As an Inquisitor, Barriss wielded her own red [[Barriss Offee's double-bladed spinning lightsaber|double-bladed spinning lightsaber]], a design that was standard amongst their ranks.<ref name="Realization" /> As the healer, she was able to defend herself without any lightsaber on hand.<ref name="The Way Out" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Development===
[[File:AhsokaBarriss-WF.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Weapons Factory director Giancarlo Volpe wanted Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee to begin a romantic relationship.]]
Offee was originally introduced in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', which was written by [[Alan Dean Foster]]<ref name="Approaching Storm">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref> before appearing that year in the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] where she was portrayed by [[Nalini Krishan]]<ref name="ImgAtk">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030523.html|series=Image Attack|text=Mirialan Master and Padawan}}</ref> and which was her first introduction from a [[canon]] perspective.<ref name="Episode II" /> Concept art of Luminara Unduli and Offee was done by [[Dermot Power]]. In Power's art work, the two are depicted with chalk white skin and the image is featured in ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]'' next to images of Kit Fisto with similar skin, who was originally designed as a potential Sith.<ref name="Art of AotC">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Indeed the image is also featured on Power's website under the section "Sith".<ref name="DPower">{{WebCite|url=https://dermotpower.com/star-wars-episode-2attack-of-the-clones|work=[[Dermot Power]]'s website|text=Star Wars Episode 2:Attack of the Clones|archivedate=20260211111619}}</ref>

Offee was originally meant to have been depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] being killed as part of Order 66, but this scene was cut along with the deaths of Luminara Unduli and [[Shaak Ti]]. A non-canon animatic was made of Offee's death showing her on Felucia fighting battle droids at the time of Order 66 when an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE]] walks up behind her and shoots her. Interestingly, toward the end of this animatic her lightsaber was depicted as being green.<ref name="BlurayScene">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', Disc 7, Star Wars Archives: Episode III Deleted Scene: Kahyyyk and Order 66 Animatic</ref> Unused footage from ''Attack of the Clones'' was going to be used for this appearance.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.ccbanana.com/main/interviews/starwars1.html|text=C.C. Banana Interviews the Stars of STAR WARS!|archivedate=November 2, 2007}}</ref> Her scrapped death in Episode III would later be incorporated into the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3|third issue]] of the Legends [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|''Revenge of the Sith'' comic adaptation]].<ref name="ROTS comic">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>

===''Star Wars: The Clone Wars''===
She was later voiced by [[Meredith Salenger]] in the [[2008]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="SWArchive-In the Hands of The Padawans…">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news11102009/index.html|text=In the Hands of The Padawans…}}</ref> In his own words, [[Giancarlo Volpe]], director of ''The Clone Wars'' episode "[[Weapons Factory]]," "secretly" pushed for Ahsoka Tano and Offee to enter a romantic relationship.<ref name="Ahsoka/Barriss">{{Tumblr|subdomain=giancarlovolpe|url=post/94796479979/gizzlescribbles-hmmm-whatever-its-late|name=Giancarlo Volpe|text=Barriss Ahsoka|date=2014-08-14|quote=I can't believe someone ships Barrissokka. You have no idea how hard I secretly pushed this agenda in <s>"Droid Factory"</s> "Weapons Factory" (thank you for pointing out my mistake - I have worked on a lot of shows, I some times get the titles confused.)"}}</ref> Offee was originally written to die in "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" by blowing up her prison cell, but supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] "had plans" for the character and cut the scene from the script.<ref name="Untold">{{SW|url=news/swca-the-untold-clone-wars-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: The Untold ''Clone Wars'' Panel Liveblog}}</ref> This story was ultimately explored in the [[2024]] animated miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'', where she was again voiced by Salenger.<ref name="TotE">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-meredith-salenger|text=In ''Tales of the Empire'', Meredith Salenger Reconnects with Barriss Offee}}</ref>

===Contradictions===
====Age====
[[File:BarrissOffee-TCWForceWarriors.png|thumb|left|300px|''Star Wars The Clone Wars'' aged down Barriss Offee from her original depiction in ''Star Wars'' Legends.]]
In [[2015]], [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] released two cards that claimed Offee built her first lightsaber at the age of seventeen,<ref name="Barriss Jedi Card" /> framing it as evidence of her scientific skill.<ref name="Barriss Sith Card">{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Chrome Perspectives|subset=Sith Information Guide|cardname=Barriss Offee|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/114595/cid/8022666/2015-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-Perspectives-Jedi-vs.-Sith-12-S-Bariss-Offee}}</ref> However, most sources say Jedi younglings make their first lightsabers at a far younger age after [[Gathering|the Gathering]] event.<ref name="TheGathering">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref> Indeed, in the short story "[[A Jedi's Duty]]," Offee reflects that younglings take on the Gathering to build their first blades, with no sign she did not take on the endeavor.<ref name="A Jedi's Duty" /> Additionally, Offee being seventeen when she made her first lightsaber<ref name="Barriss Jedi Card" /><ref name="Barriss Sith Card" /> would make her much older than Ahsoka Tano. According to Dave Filoni, Offee is only "a little bit older than" Tano.<ref name="Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]], "Return to Geonosis" DVD Featurette</ref> As such, this article assumes the Topps information about Offee's age and lightsaber are incorrect.

The older age for Offee<ref name="Barriss Jedi Card" /> more closely aligns with her depiction in ''Star Wars'' Legends, which depicted her as being around [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] age.<ref name="Approaching Storm" /> In Legends, Offee was ultimately provided the birth year of [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]]<ref name="Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi">''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]''</ref> even despite her then-developing depiction in ''The Clone Wars''. Currently in canon, no birth date exists for Offee other than Filoni's comments.<ref name="Complete Season Two" />

===="The Wrong Jedi" endeavors====
The [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Dark Side]]'' later stated that Offee had been acting as a double agent for the Sith during the events of ''The Clone Wars'' Season 5.<ref name="The Dark Side">''[[Star Wars: The Dark Side]]''</ref> The [[2021]] reference book ''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]'', framed as an in-universe text, by [[Kristin Baver]] also claimed Offee's designs were part of a "fiendishly cunning Separatist plot."<ref name="FAW">''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]''</ref> However, the episode "The Wrong Jedi" itself established that she was acting out of a hate for the dark side, despite tapping into it herself, and on her own.<ref name="The Wrong Jedi" /> This article assumes "The Wrong Jedi" is correct. Nonetheless, the [[2015]] novel ''[[Dark Disciple]]'' by [[Christie Golden]] sees Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] personally regard Offee as a "Separatist terrorist."<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> Additionally, a ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' Iconic Moments card about Offee's fall claimed it was a result of a serum that changed the Force inside of her. However, [[Leland Chee]] stated the card was never approved by his team.<ref name="Leland">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/1294817373732536320|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@missingwords @Readingforknow1 Not sure what happened. We'll usually review cards as needed but I'm not seeing this set coming in for our team's approval.|archivefile=File:CardTraderBarrissApproval.png}}</ref> However, this idea was once more touched upon in the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' release "[[Ahsoka Tano and Other Users of the Force]]," which claims that she was tainted by such an experience. This claim is only featured in the booklet's English release.<ref name="English Ahsoka and Others" />

Offee's exact rank and title at the time of her betrayal has also been a point of contradiction.
